title: Pure Duel Dragon
summary: Duel Dragon is the manga counterpart to the Signer Dragons, led by Ultimaya Tzolkin and Crimson Dragon. Using a dedicated Level 6 Synchro engine (Red Resonator, Crimson Resonator, and Soul Resonator) to easily put a Level 5+ Tuner and Level 5+ non-Tuner on the board for Ultimaya Tzolkin, setting any Spell/Trap immediately cheats out Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon, Beelze of the Diabolic Dragons, or Power Tool Braver Dragon.

allow.Soul Resonator: Level 3 Tuner that searches Bone Archfiend on Normal/Special Summon to assemble Level 6 Synchros and Level 12 Crimson Dragon.
allow.Bone Archfiend: Special Summons itself from hand or GY and dumps a Resonator to adjust Levels for Level 6 Synchros (for Ultimaya Tzolkin) or Level 12 Crimson Dragon.
allow.Vision Resonator: Level 2 Tuner that Special Summons itself and searches Crimson Gaia when sent to the GY.
allow.Crimson Gaia: Continuous Spell that searches Soul Resonator or Vision Resonator every turn.
allow.Synchro Rumble: Spell searchable by Crimson Dragon that revives a Tuner or Level 7/8 Dragon Synchro from the GY.
allow.Metalsilver Armor: Equip Spell equipped from the Deck by Power Tool Braver Dragon that prevents the opponent from targeting any monster except the equipped one.
allow.Life Extreme: Equip Spell equipped from the Deck by Power Tool Braver Dragon that boosts ATK by 1500 and destroys a card when battle positions change.
allow.Coral Dragon: Level 6 Synchro Tuner made with Level 2 Vision Resonator + Level 4 Bone Archfiend; serves as the exact Level 5+ Tuner required to summon Ultimaya Tzolkin!
allow.Stardust Charge Warrior: Level 6 non-Tuner Synchro made with Level 2 Vision Resonator + Level 4 Bone Archfiend that draws 1 card and pairs with Coral Dragon to summon Ultimaya Tzolkin!

main: Normal Summon starter that searches Bone Archfiend to assemble Coral Dragon + Stardust Charge Warrior for Ultimaya Tzolkin.
Special Summons itself from hand or GY and sends Vision Resonator from the Deck to the GY to modulate Levels to 4.
Special Summons itself while you control a Level 5+ DARK monster and searches Crimson Gaia when sent to the GY.
Searches Soul Resonator or Vision Resonator during your Main Phase so you can summon Ultimaya Tzolkin or Crimson Dragon every turn.
Searched by Crimson Dragon on Synchro Summon; revives a Tuner or a Level 7/8 Dragon Duel Dragon from your GY.
Set to trigger Ultimaya Tzolkin, negates an opponent's face-up Spell/Trap activation, and sets itself back face-down instead of going to the GY (re-triggering Ultimaya Tzolkin every turn!).
Equip Spell equipped from the Deck by Power Tool Braver Dragon that prevents the opponent from targeting any monster except the equipped one.
Equip Spell equipped from the Deck by Power Tool Braver Dragon that boosts ATK by 1500 and destroys a card when battle positions change.
extra: Signature Duel Dragon god summoned by sending 1 Level 5+ Tuner (Coral Dragon) and 1 non-Tuner (Stardust Charge Warrior) with the same Level to the GY; Special Summons 1 Level 7/8 Dragon Synchro or Power Tool Synchro whenever a Spell/Trap is Set on your field.
Level 12 Synchro that searches Synchro Rumble and returns itself to the Extra Deck as a Quick Effect to Synchro Summon any Dragon Synchro matching a targeted Synchro's Level.
Level 8 Dragon Synchro summoned by Ultimaya Tzolkin that negates any monster effect once per turn and gains ATK.
Signature Level 8 DARK Duel Dragon summoned by Ultimaya Tzolkin that cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects and gains ATK whenever you take damage.
Signature Level 8 LIGHT Duel Dragon summoned by Ultimaya Tzolkin that makes 1 face-up card you control (including Tzolkin!) immune to battle and card effect destruction once per turn.
Signature Level 7 LIGHT Duel Dragon summoned by Ultimaya Tzolkin that bounces a Special Summoned monster the opponent controls.
Level 9 Power Tool Synchro summoned via Ultimaya Tzolkin that equips up to 3 Equip Spells from Deck/GY and sends 1 Equip to negate a monster's effect or change its battle position.
Signature Level 8 DARK Duel Dragon summoned by Ultimaya Tzolkin that destroys all other face-up Attack Position monsters on the field.
Level 6 Synchro Tuner used as the Level 6 Tuner material to summon Ultimaya Tzolkin (drawing 1 card when sent to the GY!).
Level 6 non-Tuner Synchro that draws 1 card on Summon and pairs with Coral Dragon to summon Ultimaya Tzolkin.
